_status.authority: main_Tier_1_Examples_v3.xlsx (Definitions sheet) for Tier 1 thresholds and measurement conventions

title: StrategyCandidate
description: Output of a Strategy Library's eligibility evaluator (e.g. SweepEligibilityEvaluator) — reads Event and Tracker objects to determine whether a setup is a live candidate. This is the object the AI reasoning layer (per Architecture.md) actually receives, not raw Domain Model concepts.

hard_rules.description: Every HARD_GATE rule_type item for this strategy, evaluated as booleans. Hard rules stay in code and must not be overridden by the AI layer — see AI_Policy/Responsibilities.md.

soft_confluence.description: Every SOFT_CONFLUENCE rule_type item for this strategy, as weighted signals rather than booleans.

referenced_events.description: IDs of SweepEvent/OriginPoint/InefficiencyInstance objects this candidate is built from.
